title: Who Is the Tallest?
summary: Join clues into one ordered line to compare people or things.

steps.title: The puzzle
sentences: Who is the tallest, and who is the shortest?

steps.title: How to think about it
sentences: Do not try to hold everything in your head.
Turn each clue into a short chain, and then join the chains.
points: Do not try to hold everything in your head.

steps.title: The method: Draw a line
sentences: Write each name as a letter and use a greater-than sign.
A is taller than B gives A > B, and B > C.
Join them into one line: A > B > C.
points: Write each name as a letter and use a greater-than sign.

steps.title: The answer
sentences: The line reads A > B > C.
So Asha is the tallest and Charu is the shortest.
points: The line reads A > B > C.

facts: Ordering things from biggest to smallest is called ranking.

quiz.q: Ravi is older than Mani. Mani is older than Sita. Who is the youngest?
quiz.why: R > M > S, so Sita is youngest.

quiz.q: Tea is hotter than milk. Milk is hotter than water. Which is the coolest?
